title: yuzu-cure slovakian cheese omelette
description: A Slovakian twist on a classic omelette, featuring the winey flavor of stilton cheese and the tangy yuzu-cure. Perfect for a diabetic-friendly brunch option.

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup crumbled stilton cheese
ingredients.notes: diabetic-friendly option, choose a low-carb variety if possible

ingredients.name: 1 tablespoon yuzu-cure
ingredients.notes: homemade or store-bought, reduce amount if too salty

instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a fork until lightly beaten.
Heat a medium non-stick skillet over medium heat and add 1 tablespoon of the melted butter. Once melted, tilt the skillet to make sure the butter covers the entire surface.
Add the crumbled stilton cheese to one half of the skillet and sprinkle with yuzu-cure.
Pour the egg mixture over the cheese and let it cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the edges start to set.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the omelette towards the center, allowing the uncooked egg to flow to the edges.
Once the eggs are almost set, use the spatula to carefully slide the omelette over and fold the other half of the skillet over the filling.
Cook for an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute, until the cheese is melted and the eggs are cooked through.
Slide the omelette out of the skillet onto a plate and garnish with chopped chives and parsley, if desired.
